seo_title: Multi Colour Lantern Mosaic Bathroom Tiles
meta_description: Lantern mosaic tiles for bathroom walls in multi colour glazed ceramic: a classic lantern outline for feature and shower walls. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These lantern mosaic tiles for bathroom walls are glazed ceramic pieces in a lantern outline, with several colours mixed across the sheet, made for feature walls and shower backs.

## How they look
The lantern shape is an elongated outline with pointed ends and curved sides, a motif often linked with Moroccan-style and Mughal-inspired design. With multi colour lantern tiles, no two parts of the wall look exactly the same; the mix gives a lively, patterned surface. Pieces from different batches can vary, so judge the colour mix on a sample.

## Where they work
- **A shower feature wall**: lantern shape wall tiles behind the shower head or bath.
- **A vanity wall** in a guest bathroom or powder room.
- **Small accent panels**, framed by plain tiles, where a full wall would feel too busy.

Shower feature wall tiles like these look best next to a plain, single-colour floor and calm sanitaryware.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Colour: multi colour
- Shape: lantern
- Category: bathroom wall mosaic tiles
- Size and sheet layout: confirm on enquiry

Mix tiles from several boxes as you set them so the colours spread evenly. Ask your tiler about waterproofing, adhesive and grout for wet areas, and clean with a mild, non-acid cleaner.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour mix, then get a dated quote. Compare the [small arabesque mosaic](/products/glazed-ceramic-mosaic-small-arabesque-bathroom-wall-tiles) or browse the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic).

faqs.q: What is the price of lantern mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can lantern tiles be used on a whole bathroom?
faqs.a: They can, but a multi colour pattern on every wall tends to feel busy. Most bathrooms use lantern tiles on one feature or shower wall and plain tiles elsewhere.

faqs.q: Lantern or arabesque tiles: what is the difference?
faqs.a: Both are curved, interlocking shapes. Lantern tiles are usually longer with more pointed ends; arabesque shapes tend to be rounder and more ornate. A sample of each makes the difference clear.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Multi Colour Lantern Mosaic" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
